Vị trí lái khẩn cấp

A dedicated station—usually aft in the steering gear room—used to control the ship’s steering in the event of bridge steering failure.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A dedicated station—usually aft in the steering gear room—used to control the ship’s steering in the event of bridge steering failure.

Operational example

In case of bridge steering failure, transfer control to emergency steering position aft and maintain communication with the bridge via sound-powered telephone.

Localized term
